summary: Fixed both critical/high print-map defects (1702Q-P1 and 1702Q-P2) in crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_1702q.rs without changing to_bir_field_map() or official upload XML: all 12-slot monetary combs now print right-aligned whole pesos without commas or '.00' (matching official '(Do NOT enter Centavos)' and form_1702ex.rs::print_whole_pesos), and preprinted static cells (Schedule 1A Item 10 '0%', Schedule 1A Item 11 '000', Schedule 3 Item 5 '2%') are no longer overwritten. Remaining open items are shared plain-text-over-comb collisions (needs shared change) and minor layout notes.

test_data.profile: Juana Santos long-name/long-address demo profile (TIN 000-123-453-00000, RDO 008)
test_data.notes: Identical BEFORE and AFTER payload (39/42 fields applied; 3 penalty fields 21–23 refused because return is an overpayment). Schedule 4 Other Tax Credits is fixed at 2 rows (6a and 6b) with no Add row UI.

defects.description: Every monetary comb cell on Pages 1 and 2 (Part II Items 14–25 and Part IV Schedules 1–4, except Schedule 1 Col B Item 13) printed '.00' centavos and commas into whole-peso 12-slot combs even though official 1702Q specifies '(Do NOT enter Centavos)'. Fixed in form_1702q.rs::print_amount to round to whole pesos (digits only, negative in parentheses, right-aligned in 12 slots).

Preprinted static values were doubled by dynamic writes: Schedule 3 Item 5 ('2 %' -> '22%'), Schedule 1 Col A Item 10 ('0 %' -> '00%'), and Schedule 1 Col A Item 11 ('000' + '0.00'). Fixed in form_1702q.rs::to_print_field_map by omitting Sched1:txtTax11A, sched1_rate_a, and sched3_rate on print.

Long plain-text values print across comb ticks on Page 1 Item 9 Registered Address (both lines), Page 1 Item 13A treaty specify, Page 2 Header Registered Name, and Page 2 Schedule 4 Items 6a and 6b specify.
Header Item 5 second ATC row ('IC 010' / 'DOMESTIC CORPORATION IN GENERAL - 25%') sits slightly cramped against the bottom border of its boxes.
Part IV Schedule 4 Other Tax Credits/Payments is fixed at two items (6a and 6b) with no Add row control, so overflow past the 2 printed rows cannot be entered.
Official 1702Q PDF has 3 pages (Page 3 is Guidelines/Instructions); the app renders 2 form pages.

crates/bir-print/src/frozen_html.rs:5913-5916 (p1c57): official_amount(income_tax_due) -> whole-peso right-aligned integer — same 12-slot whole-peso comb rule.

crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_1702q.rs (print_field_map_adds_only_derived_keys & print_amounts_fit_the_comb_or_stay_blank): updated expected comb strings to whole pesos (including negative '(1234)') and asserted Sched1:txtTax11A, sched1_rate_a, and sched3_rate stay blank so preprinted '000', '0%', and '2%' are not doubled.
